Hon’ble NITI Aayog Member Dr. Joram Aniya Visits SAI CRC Bhopal; Extends Best Wishes to SAI CRC Bhopal Athlete Pooja Olla for Asian Games 2026
articles.full_content:
Hon’ble Member also meets Madhya Pradesh Shooting Academy shooters Shri Aishwary Pratap Singh Tomar and Ms. Ashi Chouksey, who will represent India at the Asian Games 2026 Chief Guest flags off special Teachers’ Day-themed edition of ‘Sundays on Cycle’ at SAI CRC Bhopal
A special edition of the Sundays on Cycle programme, themed around Teachers’ Day, was organised on Sunday at the Sports Authority of India Regional Centre, SAI CRC Bhopal. The programme was graced by Hon’ble Member of NITI Aayog, Dr. Joram Aniya, as the Chief Guest.
During the programme, Dr. Joram Aniya flagged off the cycling rally, participated in a plantation drive and administered the Fit India Pledge to athletes and participants. She also held a special interaction with coaches and athletes. Following the programme, the Hon’ble Member visited SAI CRC Bhopal and various sports projects and facilities in Madhya Pradesh.
At the beginning of the programme, Ms. Anshika Jain, Assistant Director, SAI CRC Bhopal, welcomed and felicitated the Hon’ble Chief Guest, Dr. Joram Aniya, with a bouquet. Dr. Joram Aniya paid floral tributes to the portrait of former President of India and eminent educationist Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan. On the occasion of Teachers’ Day, she remembered and paid tribute to Dr. Radhakrishnan for his invaluable contribution to education, values and nation-building.
Participants Cover 4 km on Cycles Athletes, coaches and officials, along with participants, took part in the special edition of Sundays on Cycle. Dr. Joram Aniya administered the Fit India Pledge to all participants, encouraging them to adopt a healthy, fit and active lifestyle.
The Hon’ble Chief Guest then flagged off the cycling rally, during which participants covered a distance of approximately 4 kilometres.
Plantation Drive Spreads Message of Environmental Conservation
Along with promoting fitness, environmental conservation was also an important aspect of the programme. Dr. Joram Aniya planted a sapling at the SAI CRC Bhopal campus, spreading the message of environmental protection and sustainability.
Direct Interaction with Coaches and Athletes on Sports Policies
During the programme, Dr. Joram Aniya held a special interaction with the coaches and athletes of SAI CRC Bhopal. She sought their suggestions and feedback on strengthening India’s sports ecosystem and making sports policies more effective.
Athletes and coaches shared their experiences, challenges and suggestions related to sports infrastructure and facilities. The interaction served as an important initiative towards ensuring that the voices and experiences of athletes and coaches contribute to the process of policy-making.
Pooja Olla Presented with the Torch of Sporting Spirit
On the occasion, Pooja Olla, who has qualified for the Asian Games 2026, was felicitated by the Hon’ble Chief Guest and extended best wishes for the upcoming international competition.

MFL Organizes Kisan Sangoshthi under PM-PRANAM at M/s Sri Mounika Traders, Godkondla (Mall) Village
articles.full_content:
Madras Fertilizers Limited (MFL), Regional Office, Hyderabad has organized Kisan Sangoshthi programme under PM-PRANAM Scheme on 05-09-2026 at M/s Sri Mounika Traders, Godkondla (Mall), Chinthapally Mandal, Nalgonda District. Venue is 18 KM away from Mall.
The programme was organized by Manager Marketing, Telangana State - Shri S. Karuppaiah.
About 30 Leading and Progressive Farmers attended. Local Dealer Shri Sheshu - Venkateshwara Fertilizers & Seeds and Local Panchayat Leader Shri Mahesh participated.
Banner was displayed and 2 Bags of Organic Manure were displayed for demonstration. Importance of Organic Manure and Balanced Fertilizers was explained in detail.
Role of PM-PRANAM - Kisan Sangosthi was explained - objectives, reduction of chemical fertilizers, promotion of organic / bio / alternate fertilizers.
Local Eminent Person working in Mounika Traders explained in Telugu for better understanding of farmers.
Farmers expressed and were much worried about their Cotton Crop due to insufficient rainfall.
Farmers demanded our Vijay 17-17-17 Complex Fertilizers as they comparing with SPIC and found Vijay superior. Importance of Balanced Fertilizer was highlighted.
Very good interactive session - farmers queries clarified.
Biscuits, Water Bottle and Cool Drinks were distributed to all farmers.
Programme successfully completed.
articles.summary: Madras Fertilizers Limited (MFL), Regional Office, Hyderabad has organized Kisan Sangoshthi programme under PM-PRANAM Scheme on 05-09-2026 at M/s Sri Mounika Traders, Godkondla (Mall), Chinthapally Mandal, Nalgonda District. The programme was organized by Manager Marketing, Telangana State - Shri S. Local Dealer Shri Sheshu - Venkateshwara Fertilizers & Seeds and Local Panchayat Leader Shri Mahesh participated.
